edits.before: Akshan wins by landing Heroic Swing, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Akshan wins by swinging in when your pool is down — three Dirty Fighting hits shield him while Comeuppance executes the retreat.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Sanguine Pool for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Akshan Heroic Swing (E): 18s at rank 1 — his engage/escape; fight only while it is down. - His R Comeuppance: 100/85/70s. - Budget your 28s W Sanguine Pool for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, E-charge as he steps to answer, release and walk — the trade costs him HP and pays yours.
edits.after: His Q Avengerang is 9s at rank 1 — after it whiffs, step up, Q the last-hit, and release E before it comes back.

edits.before: Pooling his poke and then eating the real engage at half HP with nothing — the pool is a combo-breaker, not a flinch reflex.
edits.after: Past river with pool down, Going Rogue camouflage plus an 800-range Heroic Swing turns the fog into his engage — walk with vision.

edits.before: The crimson rush timing — Q empowers every third-ish cast and the sustain war starts tilting your way.
edits.after: He still out-ranges the sustain — 850-range Avengerang chips free while your empowered Q only keeps pace.

edits.before: Hemoplague online — the all-in inverts: Q-E-R-E with ignite kills most mids who thought they were winning.
edits.after: Hemoplague online — the all-in inverts: R-Q-E with ignite kills an Akshan whose passive shield is spent.

edits.before: Riftmaker timing: every trade heals more than it costs. Extended fights are now donations to your health bar.
edits.after: Riftmaker timing: every trade heals more than it costs — his Q chip and swing burst no longer reset the math.
